description: Gas Consumption by IWPP (MMBTU) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents monthly gas consumption in MMBTU by Independent Water and Power Producers (IWPPs) in the State of Qatar. The data is broken down by specific facilities, including RAF B, RLA, MPCL, and others, and includes monthly totals. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are gas, energy, IWPP, consumption, desalination. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
